scope: Six common non-spellcasting NPC statblocks from pinned SRD 5.1
limitations: Authored Russian summaries, not official translation or a complete NPC catalog.
Base statistics are structured; attacks, skills, senses and traits remain text.
Guard armor class includes a shield; two-handed attack equipment changes are manual.
Spellcasting NPCs, Bandit Captain, Berserker, Commoner, Gladiator, Knight, Noble, Spy and Tribal Warrior remain outside this subset.
No combat, equipment, advantage or multiattack automation.
